label: PLANET IGS-5225-8T2S2X (hardware version 4)
description: PLANET IGS-5225-8T2S2X industrial Layer 3 managed switch: 8x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45, 2x 100/1000/2500BASE-X SFP (ports 9-10), 2x 10GBASE-SR/LR SFP+ (ports 11-12, backward compatible with 1G/2.5G SFP), no PoE, 66 Gbps non-blocking fabric, 49.1 Mpps, dual 9-48 V DC or 24 V AC input, IP30 DIN-rail case, -40 to 75 C.

fabric.note: 66 Gbps non-blocking and 49.1 Mpps at 64 bytes, 32K MAC table, 32 Mbit shared buffer, 10 KB jumbo frames.

notes: Datasheet C-IGS-5225-8T2S2Xv4_L.pdf, hardware version 4 (the product page's download table lists datasheet version 4.0 dated 2026-08-07). The non-PoE twin of the IGS-5225-8P2S2X: same twelve ports and the same 66 Gbps fabric, but twice the shared buffer (32 Mbit against 16 Mbit) because no PoE controller shares it. RJ45-to-RS232 console at 115200 8-N-1, 76.8 x 107 x 152 mm, 1377 g, dual 9-48 V DC with 24 V AC acceptable, reverse-polarity protection, 17.1 W idle and 24.8 W fully loaded. That low-voltage input is the substantive difference from the PoE models, which need 48-54 V DC. Layer 3: RIPv1/v2, OSPFv2, OSPFv3 and IPv4/IPv6 hardware static routing. Discrepancy: this datasheet allows 6 trunk groups of up to 12 ports (24 Gbps duplex) while the PoE model's datasheet states 6 groups of 4 ports (16 Gbps); the LACP group size is not modelled here because the two sheets disagree and neither could be confirmed on a running unit.
